title: Catalog manifest
description: packs/manifest.yaml: the ordered list of packs that make up a catalog. Authoring contract for humans and external tooling; the Go loader in internal/curriculum enforces the equivalent rules natively (see catalog-schema-loader Decision 3).

schema_version.description: Must match the loader's supported schema version exactly.

items.description: Filename relative to the manifest's own directory. Must never resolve outside it.
